Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Uttarakhand Counsellor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Counsellor post at NIT Uttarakhand?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Counsellor position at NIT Uttarakhand is 19th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology. A PhD in Psychology is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Counsellor post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Counsellor position involves a Walk-In Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Counsellor at NIT Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application for the Counsellor post at NIT Uttarakhand must be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-In Interview scheduled for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The Walk-In Interview for the Counsellor post is scheduled to be held on 23rd September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NIT Uttarakhand?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Institute of Technology Uttarakhand is https://www.nituk.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The Counsellor position at NIT Uttarakhand is a contractual job.
